base.text:
Cry: Discover an Acclaimed Unit or a Jelly Bean.
Quest: Stage 1, Initiation. Make an Acclaimed Unit Radiant. Reward: Summon a random Acclaimed Unit.
Quest: Stage 2, Comradery. Have 2 Acclaimed Units you control die. Reward: Do this {finds|time|times}: at random, add an Anomaly Found! to your hand or gain a random Stinkyscape Resource.
Quest: Stage 3, Empty the Vaults. Steal an enemy card. Reward: Steal your opponent's mana crystals, even past 4.

radiant.text:
Cry: Discover a Radiant Acclaimed Unit or a Radiant Jelly Bean.
Quest: Stage 1, Initiation. Make an Acclaimed Unit Radiant. Reward: Summon a random Radiant Acclaimed Unit.
Quest: Stage 2, Comradery. Have 2 Acclaimed Units you control die. Reward: Do this {finds|time|times}: at random, add a Radiant Anomaly Found! to your hand or gain a random Radiant Stinkyscape Resource.
Quest: Stage 3, Empty the Vaults. Steal an enemy card. Reward: Steal your opponent's mana crystals, even past 4.
